# Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (Nagarjuna Kamireddy / Nagarjuna K)

> Lead AI Architect, AI Solutions Architect, Generative AI & Agentic AI Lead, and Corporate AI Trainer with 22 years in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW/BPC/HANA consulting, and production Machine Learning & Agentic AI across India, Malaysia, Singapore, the UK, the US, and Dubai, UAE. Currently based in Dubai, UAE and available immediately on employer visa sponsorship across the UAE/GCC, global relocation, and remote leadership engagements.

Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (also published on CVs, GitHub repositories, and enterprise materials as **Nagarjuna Kamireddy**, **Nagarjuna K**, and **Nagarjun Reddy Kamireddi**) most recently served as AI Architect & Technical Lead at **John Deere** (01/2023 – 10/2026), where he owned architecture, a self-service AWS Terraform deployment platform, and delivery for a **12+ member team across 23+ AI initiatives** — generating **750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26**. He holds **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)** and **NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI)**, founded **Surya HANA Academy** (~1,000 professionals trained) and **Suryagentic Institute**, and maintains **53 public open-source AI repositories** (`github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`, 2,249+ annual contributions).

- [`governed-member-services-agent`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/governed-member-services-agent): Governed multi-tenant healthcare member-services AI agent with tool gateway, eval harness, and production design
- [`kvserve`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/kvserve): Paged-KV LLM serving engine simulator: PagedAttention block manager with refcounted automatic prefix caching (93% prefill saved), Orca continuous batching (2.4x throughput, 246x lower p99 TTFT vs static), Sarathi chunked prefill (3.8x lower p99 TPOT), recompute preemption, GQA roofline cost model & bit-exact C++20 block-hash kernel
- [`calibra`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra): Statistically rigorous LLM evaluation: paired bootstrap & exact McNemar, Bradley-Terry arena leaderboards with bootstrap CIs, 2PL IRT anchor benchmarking (38% lower error at 5% of items), temperature scaling, MinHash-LSH contamination detection & judge agreement — validated on known-truth data, bit-exact C++20 kernels
- [`weavegraph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Semantic Code-Graph Worktree Scheduler, Min-Cut Multi-Agent Task Partitioner & 3-Way AST Semantic Merge Verifier (C++20 + Python + MCP + React)
- [`vecta`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): Vector Search Engine: HNSW (heuristic neighbour selection, filtered & tombstone search) at 0.999 recall@10 touching 1.4% of vectors, IVF-PQ ADC + rerank (24x compression), RaBitQ-style 1-bit codes, BM25+RRF hybrid & bit-exact native C++20 kernels
- [`slopguard`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/slopguard): Heuristic checker for AI-generated code — Python AST + regex TS/JSX rules for stubs, unresolved imports, empty tests; C++20 prescreen, Claude Code hook, MCP
- [`tokendiet`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tokendiet): Context compressor for AI coding agents — knapsack log pruning (C++20 kernel, Python fallback), AST skeletons, cross-turn read dedup. CLI + MCP server
- [`syntara`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-Constrained Structured Decoding Engine: JSON Schema/Regex -> Minimal Byte DFA (Thompson/Rabin-Scott/Moore), Native C++20 Prefix-Sharing Token Index (112-142x, bit-exact), Byte-Level Earley CFG Constraints & Exact Closed-Set Choice Scoring
- [`tracegit`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Git-like local history for AI agent traces — SQLite/SHA-256 Merkle store, C++20 edit-distance diff/bisect, loop detection, CI gate, MCP server. Prototype
- [`nexus-verity`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/nexus-verity): Causal inference in Python — PC discovery, d-separation, cross-fitted double ML, split conformal, C++ doubly-robust OPE. Educational reference implementation
- [`aether-compiler`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aether-compiler): Small tensor-graph compiler: SSA IR with CSE/fusion/DCE passes, C++20 static arena planner, analytic H100 tile cost model. Educational reference implementation
- [`helios-consensus`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/helios-consensus): Library-style Raft in Python with segmented binary WAL, asyncio TCP, Multi-Raft sharding, Jepsen-style fault injection, WGL linearizability & C++20 kernels
- [`privora-graph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/privora-graph): Privacy & robustness toolkit — DP-SGD with RDP accounting, bi-temporal PageRank retrieval, Multi-Krum/geometric-median aggregation. Reference implementation
- [`aegis-runtime`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime): Policy and audit layer for AI-agent tool calls — custom policy DSL, saga compensation, hash-chained Merkle/Ed25519 audit log. Reference implementation
- [`prism-gate`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate): OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway prototype — TCP-Vegas adaptive concurrency, heuristic cascade routing, PSI/JSD drift checks. Reference implementation
- [`company-os`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os): CompanyOS — run ANY company with a team of AI agents. Config-driven (company.json), 7 role-agents, SIM + LIVE modes, kanban dashboard, KPI engine.
- [`surya-shiksha`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/surya-shiksha): Surya Shiksha — Multi-Agent Adaptive Learning Operating System (12 Specialized AI Agents, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL & Prisma).
- [`clicky`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/clicky): Fork of Clicky — an on-screen AI teacher buddy for macOS (Swift).

- [Eliminating Agent Loop-Thrash & Malformed Tool Calls (`tracegit` + `Syntara` + Global AI 500 & Complexity 100 Atlas)](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/articles/tracegit-syntara-deterministic-agent-traces-and-grammar-decoding.html): Empirical insights across 3,381 benchmarked repositories.

- [Verified Transformer Inference & Agent Context Compression (`AxiomZero` + `TokenDiet`)](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/articles/axiom-zero-tokendiet-speculative-kernels-sae-and-context-compression.html): Lossless C++20 speculative kernels, Top-K SAE steering, 1-UIP CDCL/RUP proof verification, and C++20 salience knapsack context pruning.
